name: size
description: Size of the spinner — small (16px), medium (24px), large (32px). Match it to the surrounding text or control. Default: 'medium'.

name: intent
description: Color intent of the spinning arc (primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, neutral). Default: 'primary'.

name: label
description: Text announced to screen readers. It is not shown on screen. Describe what is loading (e.g. "Loading comments") when the context is not obvious. A blank label falls back to the default. Default: 'Loading'.

name: decorative
description: Renders a purely visual spinner with no `role` and no label, hidden from assistive technology. Use it inside a button or other control, or when several spinners are shown together, and announce the loading state elsewhere. Default: false.
